stepUp.title: Confirm it’s you
stepUp.needed: This change needs a recent sign-in. It lasts 15 minutes.

shell.unreachable: Can’t reach AnyPlay. Check your connection and <retry>try again</retry>.

level.toNext: {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} to level {level}

overview.label: Your account
overview.deletion: Your account will be deleted on {date}. <keep>Keep my account</keep>
overview.launchersBrowsers: {launchers, plural, one {# launcher} other {# launchers}} · {browsers, plural, one {# browser} other {# browsers}}

launcher.title: Get the launcher
launcher.description: Sign in to the launcher with this account, and your friends, parties and trophies are there.

profile.lead: What your friends see when they open your profile. Who sees each part is up to you on the Privacy page.

avatar.title: Picture
avatar.description: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB. It shows round, so keep the face in the middle.

about.title: About
about.description: A line or two about you: what you play, when you're around.
about.placeholder: Co-op when I can, solo when I can't.

favourites.title: Favourite games
favourites.description: Up to {max}, by title ID. This site shows the ID. The launcher shows each game's name from your own copy.
favourites.empty: No favourite games yet. Add a title ID below.
favourites.full: You have {max} games. Remove one to add another.
favourites.badId: Use only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.

security.lead: How you sign in, and every launcher and browser that is signed in to your account.

email.title: E-mail
email.description: Where your sign-in codes go. Changing it needs a code sent to the new address.
email.invalid: Enter the new address, like name@example.com.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a code. Nobody can phish a passkey.
passkeys.empty: No passkey yet. Add one and signing in takes a touch instead of an e-mail code.
passkeys.full: You have the most passkeys an account can keep ({max}). Remove one to add another.
passkeys.confirmDescription: That device can no longer sign you in with it. You can always sign in with a code by e-mail.

devices.title: Launchers
devices.description: Every PC where the launcher is signed in to your account.
devices.empty: No launcher is signed in yet.
devices.confirmDescription: It goes offline until someone signs in on that PC again.

browsers.title: Browsers
browsers.description: Every browser signed in to this account page. We keep no more about them than when they were used.
browsers.confirmThisDescription: You go back to the start and sign in again next time.
browsers.confirmOtherDescription: It has to sign in again to open your account.

everywhere.title: Sign out everywhere
everywhere.description: Every launcher and every browser, this one too. Use it when a device was lost or someone else might have signed in.
everywhere.confirmDescription: Every launcher and browser is signed out at once, this one too.

privacy.lead: Who sees your profile and your activity. Your handle is always visible, so friends can find you.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Changes count at once, in the launcher too.

trophies.title: Trophies
trophies.detail: Your trophy counts, points and level

playtime.title: Playtime
playtime.detail: How long you played, per game

favourites.title: Favourite games
favourites.detail: Up to three games you pin

activity.title: Your activity
activity.description: What you do on AnyPlay, as your friends see it in their feed.
activity.detail: Friends see it in their feed. Strangers see no feed. Choose “{nobody}” to hide what is there and stop new items.

scores.title: Scores
scores.description: Who sees your best score on a game’s leaderboard. You always see your own.
scores.detail: Your entry and your rank on each board a game reports. A block hides you and the other person from each other.

state.friends: Friends see your entry and your rank.
state.everyone: Anyone sees your entry, including people who are not signed in: they see your handle, score and date on the board’s public page.

appearOffline.title: Online status
appearOffline.description: Applies to every launcher and browser signed in to your account.
appearOffline.label: Appear offline
appearOffline.detail: Friends see you as offline. You can still play, chat and join.

publicProfile.title: Public profile
publicProfile.description: Off until you turn it on. Applies to every launcher and browser signed in to your account.
publicProfile.label: Show a public profile
publicProfile.detail: Anyone with the link sees your level, trophies and games played. It never shows whether you are online.

playedWith.title: People you played with
playedWith.description: Turning it off adds no one new. The list stays until you clear it.
playedWith.label: Remember people I play with
playedWith.detail: Keeps the people you shared a party or game session with for 30 days, up to 50. Only you see the list.
playedWith.confirmDescription: Everyone on your list of people you played with is removed. It does not change anyone else’s list, and you can’t undo it.

connections.lead: Link the accounts you already play with, so friends can find you and see where else you are.

result.denied: {name} was not linked: the request was declined there.
result.expired: Linking {name} took too long. Start again.
result.fresh: Linking {name} needs a recent sign-in. Start again and confirm it's you.
result.taken: That {name} account is already linked to another AnyPlay account.
result.exists: You already have a {name} account linked. Unlink it first.
result.failed: Linking {name} failed. Try again in a minute.

connections.confirmDescription: Your {name} account no longer shows on your profile. You can link it again any time.

data.lead: Everything AnyPlay keeps about you is yours: take a copy, or delete the account.

export.title: Download your data
export.description: Your account, profile, friends, trophies, playtime and linked accounts, as one JSON file.

scheduled.title: Deletion scheduled
scheduled.description: Your account and everything in it will be deleted on {date}. Until then you can keep it.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Your account is deleted after 30 days; until then you can change your mind. After that it is gone, with your friends, trophies and playtime.

confirm.title: Delete your account?
confirm.description: It is deleted in 30 days. Every launcher and browser is signed out now.

compare.title: Compare trophies
compare.descriptionShared: You and {handle}, in a game you both have.
compare.signInDescription: See how your trophies stack up against {handle}.
compare.empty: You and {handle} have no game in common yet. Play a game {handle} has played and it shows up here.
compare.verdictNone: Neither of you has earned a trophy in this game.
compare.verdictLevel: You are level on points in this game.
compare.verdictAhead: You are ahead by {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} in this game.
compare.verdictBehind: {handle} is ahead by {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} in this game.
compare.caption: Trophies in {titleId}, you next to {handle}

publicProfile.missingBody: Check the spelling of the handle, or ask the player to send it again.
publicProfile.noTrophies: {handle} has not earned a trophy yet.
publicProfile.playtimeNote: {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}, {total} in total.
publicProfile.nothing: There is nothing more to show of {handle} yet.

friends.title: Friends
friends.lead: Add the people you play with, answer requests and decide who stays out.

add.title: Add a friend
add.description: Enter a player’s handle to send them a request.
add.hint: Their handle, with or without the @.
add.enterHandle: Enter the handle of the player you want to add.
add.sent: Request sent to @{handle}. You are friends once they accept.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Players who want to be your friend, and the requests you sent.
requests.empty: No open requests. When someone adds you, the request shows up here.

list.title: Your friends
list.description: See who is online and what they are playing.
list.empty: No friends yet. Add someone by their handle above; they show up here once they accept.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: Blocked players are removed from your friends and requests.
blocked.empty: You have not blocked anyone. Block a player from your friends list when you need to.

confirm.blockText: You are no longer friends and any open request is dropped. You can unblock them any time.
confirm.removeText: You stop seeing when each other is online. You can send a new request later.

trophies.title: Trophies
trophies.lead: What you earned in your games. AnyPlay keeps counts per game and grade, never trophy names or art.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: {total} earned across {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}.
totals.empty: No trophies yet. Play a game through AnyPlay and the ones you earn are counted here.

byGame.title: By game
byGame.description: Games are listed by title id, the most recent first.
byGame.detail: {earned, plural, one {# trophy} other {# trophies}} · last earned {when}

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: Get a notification on this device when a friend asks to be your friend, invites you to a party or writes to you.

device.title: This device
device.description: Each browser or phone is set up on its own. Turn this on where you want to be notified.
device.notEnabled: This cloud does not send notifications.
device.unsupported: This browser can’t receive notifications. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
device.needsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications need AnyPlay on your Home Screen. Tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then open AnyPlay from there.
device.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser’s site settings, then come back.
device.others: {count, plural, one {One other device also gets notifications. Turn them off on that device.} other {# other devices also get notifications. Turn them off on that device.}}

friend_request.label: Friend requests
friend_request.detail: Someone asks to be your friend.

party_invite.label: Party invitations
party_invite.detail: A friend invites you to a party.

message.label: Messages
message.detail: A friend writes to you. The message itself stays out of the notification.

errors.timeout: Your browser’s notification service did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.noKey: This cloud has no key to send notifications with.
errors.lostSubscription: This browser lost its subscription. Turn notifications off and on again.
errors.notAllowed: This browser did not allow notifications. They don’t work in a private window; otherwise check the site settings.
